predecessors.name: Vijayanagara Empire
predecessors.text: the Thanjavur country, governed by Sevappa Nayaka for Vijayanagara before 1532

successors.name: Thanjavur Maratha Kingdom
successors.text: the Thanjavur country, taken by Venkoji (Ekoji I) in 1675

ledger.x: 1532: Achyuta Deva Raya lets his governor Sevappa Nayaka found a hereditary kingdom at Thanjavur.
1673: Chokkanatha Nayaka of Madurai besieges Thanjavur and Vijaya Raghava dies in the battle.
1675: Madurai's hold ends when Venkoji takes Thanjavur.
1675: the Nayak kingdom of Thanjavur ends in the Maratha conquest.

wars.name: Battle of Vallamprakara (Thanjavur against Madurai)
wars.outcome: Thanjavur troops, allied with Aravidu imperial forces, defeated the army of Virappa Nayaka of Madurai.

wars.name: Battle of Toppur
wars.outcome: On 12 December 1616 Raghunatha was 'completely victorious'; Jaggaraya was killed and Rama Deva Raya was put on the throne (crowned at Kumbakonam in early 1617).

wars.name: Thanjavur's Jaffna expeditions
wars.outcome: Cankili II, placed on the Jaffna throne by Thanjavur forces, was overthrown and killed in 1619; Raghunatha sent five armies to conquer Jaffna in 1619-1621 and all failed.

wars.name: Siege of Thanjavur (1673)
wars.outcome: Chokkanatha Nayaka of Madurai besieged Thanjavur in 1673 and Vijaya Raghava died in the battle; Madurai held the city until 1675.

wars.name: Maratha conquest of Thanjavur
wars.outcome: Venkoji (Ekoji I) captured Thanjavur in 1675 and founded the Thanjavur Maratha Kingdom.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary, only a c.
